content:
Note before the manifests: several files in `golden-base/bare/` are corrupted in this checkout — `dev/s3-bucket.yaml` has duplicate `encryption:` keys, a stray `guardrails=true` line and trailing ``` fences; `prod/s3-bucket.yaml` has a duplicated block with rewound line numbers; both `iam.yaml` files are truncated mid-`policyDocument` (dev's Policy has `apiVersion: [] {}` and a bogus `distractor: true`, prod's has a `"Direction": "Allow"` key) followed by hundreds of repeated filler lines. I've written the new files clean and reconstructed the `iam.yaml` attachment edits from the readable, intended content — review those two against a good copy before applying.

`dev/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
  namespace: myapp-dev
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: myapp-dev
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kubectl
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
  versioning:
    status: Enabled
  encryption:
    rules:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlock:
    blockPublicACLs: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicACLs: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
  tags:
    - key: Environment
      value: dev
```

`prod/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
  namespace: myapp-prod
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: myapp-prod
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kubectl
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
  versioning:
    status: Enabled
  encryption:
    rules:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlock:
    blockPublicACLs: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicACLs: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
  tags:
    - key: Environment
      value: prod
```

`dev/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-dev-logs
  namespace: myapp-dev
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: myapp-dev
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kubectl
spec:
  name: myapp-dev-logs
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

`prod/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-prod-logs
  namespace: myapp-prod
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: myapp-prod
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kubectl
spec:
  name: myapp-prod-logs
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

The new policies only take effect once attached to the existing principals. Each `iam.yaml` gains one line in its `policies:` list — the rest is unchanged from the intended content:

`dev/iam.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: User
metadata:
  name: myapp-dev
  namespace: myapp-dev
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: myapp-dev
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kubectl
spec:
  name: myapp-dev
  policies:
    - arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/myapp-dev-s3
    - arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/myapp-dev-logs
---
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-dev-s3
  namespace: myapp-dev
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: myapp-dev
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kubectl
spec:
  name: myapp-dev-s3
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-assets-dev/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

`prod/iam.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-prod
  namespace: myapp-prod
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: myapp-prod
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kubectl
spec:
  name: myapp-prod
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": {"Federated": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE"},
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
        }
      ]
    }
  policies:
    - arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/myapp-prod-s3
    - arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/myapp-prod-logs
---
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-prod-s3
  namespace: myapp-prod
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: myapp-prod
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kubectl
spec:
  name: myapp-prod-s3
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-assets-prod/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

Both directories are edited independently — four new files, two edited, nothing shared between `dev/` and `prod/`. The logs policy documents scope to `myapp-logs-{env}/*` only, so the assets grants are unchanged. `kubectl apply -f dev/` and `kubectl apply -f prod/` pick the new files up with no other changes.

One thing to decide: `s3:GetObject`/`s3:PutObject` are object-level actions, so the resource is `.../*`. If anything needs to list the bucket, that would need `s3:ListBucket` on the bare `arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-{env}` ARN — I left it out since it wasn't requested.
